# Faraz Khan — UX Portfolio

> Senior UX Lead designing complex data interfaces and AI-native products for enterprise. Based in Pune, India; working since 2013. This file is a plain-text map of the portfolio for AI readers. The human-facing site is at https://www.khanfaraz.in.

Faraz leads end-to-end product design: research, interaction design, design systems, and shipping. His recent focus is enterprise data UX and interfaces where AI agents do work and humans keep the judgment.

## Case studies (client work)

- [FinVista](https://www.khanfaraz.in/case/finvista): Re-imagining a digital lending platform for India's next billion borrowers. Senior UX Lead, 2024. Native Android loan origination across 6 loan products, a 100+ component design system, and a streamlined 11-step two-wheeler loan journey.
- [Aurora](https://www.khanfaraz.in/case/aurora): Redesigning a marketing campaign platform and embedding AI in the canvas. Lead Product Designer, 2024. Rebuilt the Recurring Batch Journey configurator, embedded the Helio AI composer, cut campaign-setup clicks 3:1, shipped a 52-component design system.
- [Meridian Institute Analytics](https://www.khanfaraz.in/case/meridian): Re-imagining a university's analytics platform into one cockpit for admissions, research, and HR. Lead UX Designer, 2024. Unified four siloed Power BI dashboards into one platform with an overview-and-drill-down model and an optional AI layer. Client anonymized.
- [Jack of All Threads](https://www.khanfaraz.in/case/joat): India's first crowdfunding platform for custom apparel. Product / UX Designer, 2015. In-browser design studio, campaign-creation flow, and the buyer and raiser journeys across desktop and mobile.

## AI-native concepts (self-initiated)

- [Slate](https://www.khanfaraz.in/case/slate): An AI recruiting workspace for staffing agencies. The AI sources, ranks, and drafts outreach; the recruiter stays the decision-maker. Designed end to end and built as a working interactive prototype. Prototype: https://www.khanfaraz.in/slate/
- [Crux — the Control Room](https://www.khanfaraz.in/case/crux): An AI-agent supervision console for an enterprise analytics team. Renders the five Agent Experience trust patterns as working interface: intent preview before an agent acts, an autonomy dial that re-routes work between "waiting on you" and "flowing through", calibrated confidence that forces escalation below a threshold, an action audit with before/after diffs and incident replay, and an escalation pathway that hands the human a full context package. Prototype: https://www.khanfaraz.in/crux/

## How the concepts are made (honest posture)

The self-initiated concepts are reconstructed from secondary research. No primary research was conducted, and no metrics, users, or usability tests are claimed. Each concept states plainly what could not be validated and how it would be validated with real access.
